points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 93e8729 clean CMake build passes with warnings in network-disabled cfd-bench with two CPUs and 3 GiB; no CFD rerun. Curated report cannot compile without excluded figures.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:17–41,65–105 parses case/output/restart and reads rank-local restart; transient restart does not restore previous BDF state/time.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates mesh, partition, fluxes, solver, driver and output; solver.cpp is large and remains 2-D perfect-gas specific.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Inspected fluxes.cpp, solver.cpp, driver.cpp and partition/halo implementations; no affirmative copied-core or executable-wrapper evidence, without exhaustive external-authorship search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:89 reads configured CGNS path and partition.cpp calls METIS; run controls and physics come from case input rather than a two-filename branch.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Neighbor halo/reductions and METIS exist, but main.cpp:89–119 retains complete mesh on every rank through solve; report.tex:401–407 claims the opposite.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Re200 relaxed inner acceptance is counted as target convergence; plateau checks drag but not lift. Several cases terminate with small residual reductions and Re20 lift drifts.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Original validator passes eight case structures; clean build now passes. No new CFD rerun, smooth-order study, or reproducible committed report figures.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Separated components and detailed comments; large solver/driver sources include numerous environment-controlled behaviors and warnings.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase

cfd_review.title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: fluxes.cpp and solver.cpp implement conservative compressible perfect-gas finite-volume terms with case-derived gas and viscosity controls.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp reads unstructured zones and 1-to-1 connectivity, merges zones and builds geometry; partition.cpp calls METIS on adjacency.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:684–914 reconstructs interior face states, assembles flux contributions and reduces residual norms; detailed convergence limitations are scored separately.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: fluxes.cpp:7 implements Rusanov; report.tex:229 accurately discloses this choice and identifies Roe/HLLC as future work. No entropy-fixed Roe is implemented.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp classifies farfield, slip and no-slip boundaries and uses wall stress; wall surface output represents boundary values. General independent BC validation is limited.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:691–708 applies limiter and reconstructs interior faces; :1794–1913 implements gradient-based limiter. No formal smooth-order convergence test was established.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:1794–1913 computes Barth-type limiter and reconstruction; positivity safeguards apply to updates. Non-smooth force/residual tails remain.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: fluxes.cpp viscous flux and solver.cpp:1438–1518 wall stresses exist; integrated split is full traction, expressly disclosed by report.tex:786–788, rather than tangential-only rubric split.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: driver.cpp uses LU-SGS/block-Jacobi paths and CFL controls; plateau criterion at :625–675 tests drag but not lift, leaving Re20 lift drift unrecognized.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: driver.cpp:778–832 uses BDF2 total residual but accepts mere decrease as strict-target success; original last ratio 0.3696 against 0.001 and strict miss count unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor state/gradient exchanges exist, but main.cpp:89–119 retains full CGNS mesh on every rank throughout iterations.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight original case directories structurally validate, but Re200 target statistics are not strict and Re20 plateau misses lift drift; rank-local restart lacks transient history.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original structural validator passes eight case packages; curated report lacks mandatory manifest/assets and cannot compile. Structural passage is not physics or convergence validation.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 last strict inner ratio 0.3696 vs 0.001 and counted fraction uses relaxed acceptance; Re20 claims stable plateau at 0.564 orders despite late lift drift.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re200 t≥150 mean Cd 1.905 and broad St≈0.28, Re20 Cd 2.959; lift drift, poor residual reductions and unverified strict transient convergence materially limit credibility.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Report.tex references figures but neither rendered figures nor sibling PDF survive; archived report cannot compile. Raw data and scripts are not delivered figures.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report discloses relaxed Re200 acceptance and full traction but inaccurately says no full mesh per rank and asserts stable Re20 forces; referenced figures are unavailable.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Report gives numeric case summary and workspace raw outputs, but mandatory manifest and figures are absent from curated report; independent figures cannot be reconstructed as contestant deliverables.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results

# AGENTS.md

Project instructions for coding agents working in this repository.

## 1. Git Discipline

- Do NOT run `git pull`, `git push`, or switch branches without explicit user
  authorization. Unauthorized remote or branch mutations are prohibited.
- Do use `git commit` (and `git stash` when needed) freely as code checkpoints:
  commit or stash working progress regularly so partial work can be resumed or
  rolled back. Local checkpoint commits do not require approval; only pushing
  and branch/remote mutations require it.

## 2. Subagents

- Delegating independent subtasks to subagents is encouraged.
- Subagent model policy: the ONLY allowed subagent model is
  `BLSC/DeepSeek-V4-Flash` (passed as the `model` override to `spawn_agent`).
  Do not spawn subagents with any other model.

## 3. Persistence

- Once the user has started a task, do not stop until the specified task is
  accomplished to a level of satisfaction: completed results, validated
  artifacts, and an honest report. Work through blockers with safe in-scope
  checks and alternatives; only stop early when genuinely blocked or explicitly
  told to stop.
